name: NEET/JEE Coaching For Tribal Students
benefit:
Reimbursement of institute fees up to Rs. 55,000.
Provision of Rs. 1,000 per month for food and accommodation.
Full coverage of stationary expenses, amounting to Rs. 5,000 one-time.
_eligibility_text: 1. Belong to a tribal community. 1. Have successfully completed 12th grade in the science stream with a first-class standing.
